page.title: Vyakulumikizga
page.intro: Lumikizani ma akaunti ghinu ghakusaska. Ma leads kufuma ku malonda ghinu ghakufika mu My Leads mwaŵene, na ndalama na mtengo pa lead waliyose.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form yikulongozga mu Ŵalongozgi ŵane, kugwiriskira ncito zuŵa na zuŵa na mtengo pa kulongozga, ndipo mtundu wa kulongozga ukutumizgikaso ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn yalumikizgika. Ŵanthu awo ŵakulongozga ŵakutoleka sono - hamba ili likusintha mu nyengo yichoko waka.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn yindakhazikike pa seva iyi. Mulongozgi wakwenera kusazgapo ID ya kasitomala wa pulogiramu LinkedIn na chisisi.
banner.expired: Kulumikizana LinkedIn kwamara, ntheura ŵakulongozga ŵakukolerana yayi. Lumikizaniso kuti mulutilire.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn yikukhumba kuti munjilireso pa {{date}} . Lumikizaniso pambere nyengo iyo yindakwane kuti vilongozge vilutilire kwenda.

connect.title: Lumikizani LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sayinani na akaunti LinkedIn iyo yikulaŵilira malonda ghinu. Leadrat wakuŵazga waka ma akaunti ghinu gha malonda, Lead Gen Form wakulongozga na viŵelengero vya malonda, ndipo wakutuma kusintha uko mwasintha.
connect.need1: Mulimo pa akaunti LinkedIn yakusaska (Wakuwonelera panji pachanya).
connect.need2: Mulimo pa tchati cha kampani yakukolerana (Mulongozgi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Mulongozgi panji Munthu wakusanda) - LinkedIn yikukhumba kuti yigaŵane na ŵalongozgi.
connect.need3: Fumbo la nambala ya foni pa Lead Gen Forms - ŵalongozgi ŵambura nambala ya foni ŵangasazgikirapo yayi.

connection.title: Kulumikizana
connection.autoRenews: Kufika kukusinthika mwaŵene mpaka nyengo iyo
connection.syncResult: Kukolerana kwachitika: {{received}} kupokelera, {{created}} kupangika, {{duplicates}} kukopera, {{rejected}} kukana.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Kuleka kulumikiza LinkedIn ? Kusinthaniska kukuleka ndipo ma tokeni ghakunjilirapo ghakufumiskikapo. Ŵakulongozga, viŵelengero na chikalata cha ntchito vikusungika.
connection.noPermission: Mungawona hamba ili. Kulumikiza na kusintha vyakuŵikamo kukukhumbikwira chizomerezgo cha "Kulaŵilira vyakuŵikamo".
connection.fetchHint: Ma lead ghaphya ghakuwonekera pa mphindi zichoko waka ndipo mazuŵa 7 ghakumasinda ghakuwonekeraso zuŵa lililose, ntheura palije icho chikusoŵa. Gwiliskirani nchito ivi pa ŵalongozgi kufuma pambere mundalumikizgike, panji kuti muwoneso nyengo (mpaka mazuŵa 90 pa nyengo yimoza). Kulongozga kale mu Leadrat kukujumphika.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} kwasangika, {{created}} kwapangika, {{duplicates}} kukopera, {{rejected}} kukanika, {{skipped}} kwatumizgika kale.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Uphalirani LinkedIn kuti ni vichi ivyo vikalongozga ivyo vikazgoka vigomezgo vyeneko. Para LinkedIn lead wakufika pa msinkhu uwo mwasankha musi umu, Leadrat wakuphalira LinkedIn , ntheura malipoti ghinu gha kampeni ghakulongora mtundu wa lead ndipo LinkedIn yingasanga ŵanthu ŵanandi nga ni lead yinu yiwemi. ID ya LinkedIn pera na hash ya nthowa yimoza ya email ndivyo vikutumizgika.
capi.noRules: Palije ma status agho ghali kuŵikika pa mapu.
capi.created: Kusintha kwapangika pa LinkedIn na mapu.
